eps.d: In a special edition of the heritage series, Kirsty Wark invites viewers to nominate a post-war building to be saved for posterity. The best suggestions will be featured in a new season of the programme beginning in the summer.
Simon Thurley reports on the dome of St Paul's Cathedral in London, Howard Castle in Yorkshire and the Radcliffe Camera in Oxford. Leslie Phillips visits Wilton House.
Celebrating the golden age of public transport - when railway stations were cathedrals, journeys were to be enjoyed and inventors sought new ways of getting around.
The magic of fountains, the genius of Antonio Canova and the power of the gargoyle are all celebrated in a programme marking the Year of Public Sculpture, 2000.
